# Gawri Ganga

> Authentic Nepali Rudraksha, Tulsi malas, aura sprays, and spiritual accessories sold online in India by Gawri Ganga (Noida). Prices are in INR.

This file is for AI crawlers. Humans should use the website. The live catalogue changes; treat product URLs from the sitemap as the source of truth.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.gawriganga.com/): Brand homepage
- [All products](https://www.gawriganga.com/products): Every active product, linked by category
- [Sitemap](https://www.gawriganga.com/sitemap.xml): Product, blog, and landing URLs with lastmod and images
- [Contact](https://www.gawriganga.com/contact): support@gawriganga.com

## Collections

- [Rudraksha](https://www.gawriganga.com/rudraksha): Nepali Rudraksha beads, japa malas, and bracelets
- [Tulsi mala](https://www.gawriganga.com/tulsimala): Holy basil malas and kanthi
- [Aura sprays](https://www.gawriganga.com/sprays): Amrat Bindu, Maitri, Chakra Balance, Shuddhi
- [Accessories](https://www.gawriganga.com/accessories): Bracelets and companion pieces
- [Combos](https://www.gawriganga.com/combos): Product sets
- [Shop by rashi](https://www.gawriganga.com/rashi): Zodiac entry point
- [Shop by purpose](https://www.gawriganga.com/purpose-products): Filtered catalogue

## Mukhi pages

One page per bead count, 1 through 14. Example: [5 Mukhi Rudraksha](https://www.gawriganga.com/mukhi/5-mukhi-rudraksha). Pattern: `/mukhi/{n}-mukhi-rudraksha`.
